snippet.title: Magic: The Gathering: Duels of the Planeswalkers (PC, PS3, Xbox 360)
snippet.description:
In this developer diary, Magic developers discuss how they created a whole new level of gameplay for Duels 2012 and advanced features, fresh graphics, improved deck editing, new opponents, unique challenges, multiplayer format, and much more.

For more Comic-Con 2011 coverage, check out: http://www.gamespot.com/6324595
